The environment permits key-first pickup, so this omission matters. Replace Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open) with a hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key). Keep the hard Existence(target_picked_up), Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up). Do not keep the ball-to-door precedence as well: the new chain already implies it, so it would be redundant.
